reasons: Cited §8.2–8.3 genuinely meet the preferred position: 12-month (not multi-year) auto-renewal, 30-day Customer opt-out window, 60-day Vendor reminder with deadline extension if not sent, and uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
Deterministic check confirms notice window = 30 days, within both preferred (≤30) and fallback (≤60) thresholds.
Consistent with a compliant claim, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output.
Rationale correctly scopes out the three-year initial term in §8.1 as a negotiated initial commitment rather than an auto-renewal term, avoiding over-flagging.
